title: Improve build system!
body:
This is more of a suggestion, but please use a proper (or modern) build system. 
As this project grows, Makefiles can simply become confusing garbage. 
I would highly recommend using **Cmake or Meson** as your build system here.

Not only would using a proper build system simply make the developer's lives easier, but it would also allow other projects to **easily** use this library in their projects.
author: lagoon107
